Author: Local
Name: DualSense Lighting
Description: Custom USB DualSense lighting with a live preview. Separate combat SFX prototypes offer original single-color brightness pulses or a low/high color blend with visible quiet-state lighting. Includes RGB animations and independent white player indicators. Custom lights turn off and controller handles close automatically when FFXIV loses focus, so other lighting apps can take over. Background game lighting is always guarded. Native haptics, speaker and triggers pass through.
Punchline: Custom DualSense lighting with protection for other apps.
